description: Find statistical datasets in the catalog (Eurostat, World Bank, OECD, etc.). Index-backed hybrid search (name/code + embeddings). Optional country and source_name filters. Use this instead of SELECT … FROM main ILIKE. Returns compact cards, not series values.

country.description: Optional country name to prefer datasets that include this geo (e.g. 'Germany').

query.description: What to find, e.g. 'GDP annual current prices' or 'unemployment rate'.

source_name.description: Optional source filter, e.g. 'Eurostat', 'World Bank' (World Development Indicators), 'OECD', 'IMF'.

name: search_catalog
